title: Prompt Engineering: Ten Multiple-Answer Questions
description:
Ten questions, five independently true/false statements each, fifty points total. Any number of statements can be true. Judge the actual wording, evidence, tool authorization and target rather than guessing a pattern.

Current paste-ready practice prompt:
https://github.com/nikbearbrown/info-7375-prompt-engineering-for-generative-ai/blob/main/fall-2026-exam/EXAM-GENERATOR-PROMPT.md

Course book and materials:
https://github.com/nikbearbrown/info-7375-prompt-engineering-for-generative-ai

Format: five cases ×10 points + ten multiple-answer questions ×5 points =100 points. These are practice instructions, not private exam questions or answer keys. The compact topic inventory is still an instructor-review draft; follow the latest announced scope.

Narrated by Liam for Nik Bear Brown.

title: Prompt Engineering: Five Questions for Every Case
description:
How to answer five specific questions in each of five 10-point cases: identify a justified defect, name the concept, propose a concrete check, rewrite the instruction, and explain the consequence plainly. The rubric is 3/2/2/2/1.
